// The load-bearing artifact: adapt a raw CDP getFullAXTree into webnav's SnapNode[]
// contract — the same shape parseSnapshot produces from playwright's YAML. If an
// extension ships THIS adapter over its debugger-API getFullAXTree, its snapshots feed
// the engine identically to playwright's. Calibrated against playwright's actual output.
import type { AXNode } from './cdp.mts';
import type { SnapNode } from '../../../src/playwright/snapshot.js';

// CDP roles playwright folds away (text is merged into parent names) or that are the
// document root. Dropping these makes the two producers structurally comparable.
const DROP = new Set(['RootWebArea', 'StaticText', 'InlineTextBox', 'LineBreak', 'none', 'presentation']);
// CDP role token → playwright/ARIA vocabulary. (Discovered empirically from calibration;
// this map IS the "distillation work" the spike measures — small + mechanical.)
const ROLE_MAP: Record<string, string> = { image: 'img' };

function prop(n: AXNode, name: string): unknown {
  return n.properties?.find((p) => p.name === name)?.value?.value;
}

/** AX tree (flat, childIds-linked) → SnapNode[] in document order, depth = nesting.
 *  Every emitted node gets a synthetic ref (b1,b2,…) — playwright refs every node too,
 *  and cross-resolve compares fingerprints (role+name+near), never the ref strings. */
export function adaptAXTree(nodes: AXNode[]): SnapNode[] {
  const byId = new Map(nodes.map((n) => [n.nodeId, n]));
  const root = nodes.find((n) => !n.parentId) ?? nodes[0];
  const out: SnapNode[] = [];
  let ref = 0;
  const visit = (id: string, depth: number) => {
    const n = byId.get(id);
    if (!n) return;
    const rawRole = n.role?.value ?? '';
    const kept = !n.ignored && rawRole && !DROP.has(rawRole);
    let childDepth = depth;
    if (kept) {
      const role = ROLE_MAP[rawRole] ?? rawRole;
      const nm = (n.name?.value ?? '').trim();
      const url = prop(n, 'url');
      out.push({
        role,
        name: nm || null,
        ref: 'b' + (++ref),
        url: typeof url === 'string' && url ? url : null,
        raw: `${role}${nm ? ` "${nm}"` : ''} [ref=b${ref}]`,
        depth,
      });
      childDepth = depth + 1;
    }
    for (const c of n.childIds ?? []) visit(c, childDepth);
  };
  visit(root.nodeId, 0);
  return out;
}
